name: flowkey – Learn to Play Piano
description:
flowkey makes it fun and easy to play your favorite songs on piano – whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced player. All songs and courses are created by professional pianists, with interactive lessons, practice tools, and instant feedback to help you learn piano the way that works for you.

Choose from thousands of beautifully-arranged piano pieces covering all genres, including: Classical, Pop, Film & TV and more. With songs available in four difficulty levels, you’ll always find new pieces to play. 

If you’re a beginner, learn piano step by step – with courses on how to read sheet music, navigate the keyboard, and play songs with both hands. flowkey’s beginner piano lessons are easy to follow and are a great way to learn piano fundamentals.

Experienced piano players can sharpen their skills with in-depth tutorials covering scales, chords and improvisation. 

All you need to learn piano and play your favorite songs is the flowkey app, your device (phone, tablet or laptop), and an instrument. flowkey works with acoustic pianos, digital pianos, and keyboards.

name: Felt: Greeting Cards & Gifts
description:
Felt is the highest quality, most personal way to send real, handwritten cards and photos to friends and loved ones. Your handwriting is 100% authentic, like you wrote it with pen and paper. It’s personal mail for the modern world: beautiful, fun and couldn’t be simpler.

SHARK TANK | INSTYLE | NPR | NY TIMES | SXSW | REALSIMPLE | BRIT+CO | GLAMOUR

Use Felt for every occasion:

- Photo Cards
- Thank You
- Birthdays
- Holidays
- Grandparents
- Babies
- Weddings
- Graduations
- Travel
- Invitations 
- Father’s Day
- Mother’s Day
- Anniversary & Love
- Thinking of You
- Get Well Soon
- Congratulations

DETAILS

 - Felt cards are mailed within 24 hrs. Monday - Friday.

 - Cards are 4 inches wide x 4.5 inches tall. We call them card frames. You can connect up to four frames to create one amazing card!

 - Select from cards made by famous designs and discover unique works by independent artists.

 - We use premium Mohawk paper and envelopes.

 - We hand apply a first class stamp.

 - You can send your Felt card to one person or multiple recipients at once.

 - Felt cards start at just $4.50 (including postage) or send 3 cards for $6 a month.

 - Volume discounts are available in the app for larger card sending needs.

 - Make it a gift by adding fresh-cut flowers, real cash money or select a gift card from popular brands.

 - Adding contacts is easy! Import them right from your phone into the app or upload a spreadsheet here: https://myfelt.feltapp.com/addressbook.
